The state of the Celestial Empire of Zhen Dan is deeply unsettled, an age known as one of darkness and discord. The Dragon Emperor and the Moon Empress have been missing for over a century. Self-styled sovereigns have risen in rebellion, bandits in distant provinces defy authority with impunity believing the emperor far away, and the sons of Hao Long each hold their own domains like tigers crouched and bears at bay, ruling independently. As the lords squabble over this power vacuum, the enemies of Zhen Dan seize the chance to rise in swarms. In the south, the Monkey King has seized the lands of the Celestial Court—something he would never have dared while the Dragon Emperor still reigned; across all of Zhen Dan, the Tzeentchian cult quietly rises to power, sparking internal conflict and tearing at the already strained relations among the Dragon-kin; north of Chang Yuan, the hunting packs of ruin roam the wastelands, and the followers of the Dark Gods hammer at the gates of the Celestial Empire...\\n\\n[[col:white]]Control provincial capitals directly, or through [[img:icon_vassal]][[/img]]Vassal Agreements and [[img:icon_military_alliance]][[/img]]Military Alliances with Zhen Dan factions, to unify the strength of the Celestial Empire[[/col]]\\n\\n[[col:yellow]]Provincial Support (0-25%):[[/col]]\\n[[col:yellow]]Mountains and rivers lie broken, and darkness and discord fill Zhen Dan[[/col]]
